循環解除是通過條件之一；若 watchdog 以丟棄恢復，需另外驗證上層重傳與資料完整性，不能稱全程無損。
lossless fabric 可能形成循環等待；本課以三佇列依賴圖理解 watchdog 的取捨，並區分解除死鎖與無損保證。
optionsEn: A long pause may be a genuine cycle or a slow downstream service that continues making progress. Duration alone does not establish deadlock, and a static graph must be linked to actual dependency evidence. Compare waiting relationships, dequeue counters and duration. Continuing departures are evidence of progress; preserve that evidence instead of declaring a deadlock from a large pause-duration counter alone.

Eliminating cycles is one acceptance condition. If a watchdog restores progress by dropping traffic, separately verify retransmission and end-to-end integrity; restored liveness does not prove an entirely lossless history.
A lossless fabric can contain cyclic waiting dependencies. Use a three-queue graph to understand watchdog tradeoffs and distinguish breaking a deadlock from guaranteeing lossless delivery.

quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. A lossless fabric can contain cyclic waiting dependencies. Use a three-queue graph to understand watchdog tradeoffs and distinguish breaking a deadlock from guaranteeing lossless delivery. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Trace A-B-C-A by hand to identify three members. After removing one edge, a topological order exists and cycle exposure becomes zero, although the instantaneous queued data can still total 192 KiB. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

If a watchdog restores progress by dropping traffic, separately verify retransmission and end-to-end integrity; restored liveness does not prove an entirely lossless history.
Reverify this criterion: Trace A-B-C-A by hand to identify three members. After removing one edge, a topological order exists and cycle exposure becomes zero, although the instantaneous queued data can still total 192 KiB. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。長暫停可能是死鎖，也可能是下游服務速度慢但仍持續前進；兩者需要不同證據；對照等待關係、出隊計數與持續時間；若出隊仍增加，記錄活性而非宣稱完全死鎖。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. A long pause may be a genuine cycle or a slow downstream service that continues making progress. Duration alone does not establish deadlock, and a static graph must be linked to actual dependency evidence. Compare waiting relationships, dequeue counters and duration. Continuing departures are evidence of progress; preserve that evidence instead of declaring a deadlock from a large pause-duration counter alone.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.

steps.instruction:

Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
